traits.name: Adaptability
traits.summary: Gain Skill Focus as a bonus feat at 1st level.

traits.name: Elf Blood
traits.summary: Count as both elf and human for effects related to race.

traits.name: Elven Immunities
traits.summary: Immune to magical sleep and gain +2 on saves against enchantment.

traits.name: Low-Light Vision
traits.summary: See twice as far as humans in dim light.

alternateTraits.name: Ancestral Arms
alternateTraits.summary: Gain Exotic Weapon Proficiency or Martial Weapon Proficiency with one weapon at 1st level.

alternateTraits.name: Arcane Training
alternateTraits.summary: Choose one arcane favored class and use its spell-trigger and spell-completion items as if one level higher.

alternateTraits.name: Sociable
alternateTraits.summary: Retry a failed attempt to change a creature's attitude even when it failed by 5 or more.

alternateTraits.name: Water Child
alternateTraits.summary: Gain +4 Swim, always take 10 while swimming, and allow Aquan as a bonus language.
